I choose **Uber**. 

**Why it's the best all-around choice:**
* **Global Availability:** It is available in more than 10,000 cities across 70+ countries, making it the most reliable app if you travel internationally.
* **Variety of Options:** From budget-friendly shared rides (UberX Share) to luxury black cars (Uber Black), pet-friendly rides (Uber Pet), and large vehicles (UberXL), it has the widest fleet variety.
* **Safety Features:** It includes robust safety tools like RideCheck (which detects unusual stops or crashes), audio recording, and quick emergency assistance buttons.
* **All-in-One Ecosystem:** You can use the same app to order food (Uber Eats), rent scooters/bikes, or even book rental cars and flights in select markets.

**Best Alternatives (Depending on your location):**
* **In the US & Canada:** **Lyft** (Great for comparing prices with Uber; often slightly cheaper depending on the time of day).
* **In Europe & Africa:** **Bolt** (Often significantly cheaper than Uber in these regions).
* **In Southeast Asia:** **Grab** (Uber actually sold its Southeast Asian operations to Grab; it is the dominant "super-app" there). 
* **In Latin America & China:** **DiDi** (The largest ride-hailing platform in the world by user count, dominating Asia and parts of Latin America).
